testimonials.label: PARTNER VOICES
testimonials.title:
Don't take our word for it.
Hear from the operators.

items.name: Alex Wong
items.headline: I haven't done a single thing since we installed it.
items.text: CrossFit members are immediate — you bring something in, they react right away, good or bad. Protein King just settled in quietly from the first week. I didn't introduce it or promote it. Members found it on their own. Nothing comes in from the ops side either, so I just stopped thinking about it. I've done absolutely nothing since we installed it, and it's still running. Honestly, that's what real convenience feels like.

items.name: Sarah Chan
items.headline: The atmosphere changed.
items.text: After class, members would say goodbye and walk straight out. That always felt like a missed opportunity. Since Protein King came in, people started lingering — waiting for their drink, chatting with other members. The studio energy naturally carried past the session. The revenue is great, but that shift in atmosphere was honestly the bigger surprise.

items.name: Kevin Choi
items.headline: I've never once thought it was the wrong call.
items.text: We tried RTD showcases first, and honestly, it wasn't what I expected. Inventory was a hassle, margins were thinner than I thought, and it just created more work for staff. Switching to Protein King made all of that disappear. Members actually prefer it over buying RTDs. I've never once thought it was the wrong call.

items.name: Jenny Ng
items.headline: The bigger the facility, the more this matters.
items.text: At scale, operational simplicity is everything. Every time we bring something in here, it creates a staff member, and complaints follow. With Protein King, there's been zero maintenance contact in two months. Restocking just happens. The bigger the facility, the more something like this matters.

items.name: David Lam
items.headline: Operations approved it faster than I expected.
items.text: In hotel fitness, anything you bring in needs operations sign-off first. Does it add labour costs? Who handles cleaning and maintenance? All of that has to be sorted. Protein King checked every box: no cost, self-managed maintenance, automated settlement. Operations approved it faster than I expected.

items.name: Jimin Lee
items.headline: It solved a need I couldn't figure out how to fill.
items.text: Climbing is high-intensity — members always want something right after they come off the wall. But there was never a clean solution. A protein bar shelf felt off. Stacking RTDs was awkward. Protein King just solved it cleanly. Members love it, and not having to manage it myself is honestly one of the biggest draws.

items.q: How does the revenue share work?
items.a: Revenue is shared as a percentage of sales, with the exact rate negotiated during consultation based on your facility. Monthly payouts. A flat space rental fee model is also available — both can be discussed during consultation.
Yes. The machine, delivery, and installation are all covered by Protein King. No deposit, no conditions — completely free.
Protein King covers everything — repairs, parts, and all after-sales service. You don't need to contact anyone or pay anything.
Protein King monitors stock levels and handles all refills. You don't need to track inventory or make any requests. Arrangements can be adjusted based on your facility.

items.q: Is there a minimum contract term?
items.a: The minimum term is 1 year. After that, renewal is agreed upon by both parties.

items.q: What types of facilities can apply?
items.a: No specific requirements. Any fitness-related facility can apply, regardless of size.
